posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
With vanilla RM2k3, there are only two ways I can think of, both not ideal:
1. Use "transform" to transform the enemy into another enemy that has a different graphic in which the enemy seems repositioned, the downside is that animations and damage popups are still played on the center of the image regardless of where you put the actual graphic within that image.
2. Use several instances of the enemy in different positions and set all but one to hidden, then when you want to "move" an enemy, use the "show hidden enemy" function to show it at the new position and kill the old instance. The downside is that you would have to manually set its HP/MP/stats/conditions on the new instance to match the old, and during changing the HP of the new instance and killing the old instance the player will probably see weird numbers popping up representing that change and also get the enemy kill sound for the old instance.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
RM2K3 has no scripts or plugins.
There are only two ways to change that old engine:
either you event the entire battle, or you program a patch that changes the default battlesystem.
Both ways require extensive programming knowledge to succeed.

I never really knew the specifics, since the game was basically packed with something similar to Virtualbox, but a game in RPG Maker 2003 used basically animations for this.
